in_hindi.name: मिथ्लेश
in_hindi.meaning: मिथु: पिता, दosti (friend) + लेश: द्वार, तरफ़ (bridge, direction)

in_marathi.name: Mithlesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithlesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'mit' (Moon) and 'lesh' (Goddess), the name Mithlesh signifies the 'Moon Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is considered the god of emotions and the giver of happiness. This name is believed to bring peace, tranquility, and emotional balance.
